concepts.title: Productivity and Collaboration
concepts.description: Best practices for activities, tasks, and team selling.

quizzes.title: Advanced Productivity and Activities Configuration
quizzes.description: Assess advanced Salesforce configuration across To Do List, Shared Activities, calendars, and email integration.

questions.question: Which icon is used to filter tasks in the To Do List?
questions.explanation: The funnel icon represents narrowing down visible results with filters.

questions.question: Which icon opens sorting options?
questions.explanation: Vertical arrows indicate ascending or descending ordering.
questions.hint: It is tied to list order.

questions.question: In the filter menu, which group lets you choose Tasks, Cadences, or Work Items?
questions.explanation: The 'Apply to:' section defines the high-level scope where filters are applied.
questions.hint: Look at the top filter section.

questions.question: Which is a valid Action Type filter set?
questions.explanation: Action Type categorizes by engagement/action channel.

questions.question: What happens while typing in the To Do List search box?
questions.explanation: Search provides real-time suggestions to speed up discovery.

questions.question: What does the blue cadence icon represent in To Do List navigation?
options: A cadence with steps and pending work
questions.explanation: It indicates Sales Engagement cadence-related pending actions.

questions.question: When expanding a task card, where is the cadence step typically shown?
questions.explanation: Cadence step context is surfaced at the top for quick execution clarity.

questions.question: With Shared Activities enabled, what is the max number of contacts linked to one task/event?
questions.explanation: The commonly documented limit for multi-contact association is 50.

questions.question: In high-volume orgs, how long can Shared Activities activation take?
questions.explanation: Activation can take up to 48 hours in heavy-volume scenarios.

questions.question: If the primary contact is removed from a task under Shared Activities, what happens?
options: The next related contact becomes primary
It remains without a primary contact forever
questions.explanation: Salesforce automatically promotes the next related contact to primary.

questions.question: To auto-relate attendees in events, which setting must be enabled?
options: Allow Users to Relate Multiple Contacts to Tasks and Events
questions.explanation: Auto-relate attendee behavior depends on multi-contact task/event relationships.
questions.hint: It is a Shared Activities prerequisite.

questions.question: For a 'Quick Meet' Global Action, what should the Target Object be?
questions.explanation: Quick Meet is intended for creating meetings, so it targets Event.

questions.question: What is the correct predefined formula value for Subject = Meeting?
questions.explanation: Literal text values in predefined formulas must be wrapped in double quotes.

questions.question: Where is Gmail/O365 sending enabled in Setup?
options: External Email -> Send through External Email Services
questions.explanation: External service sending is configured under External Email settings.

questions.question: Which permission is required to send through external email services when not included by profile?
options: Send Email through External Email Services
questions.explanation: This permission grants use of external email providers from Salesforce.

questions.question: With Enhanced Email enabled, which record is created in addition to Task?
questions.explanation: Enhanced Email persists outbound/inbound message data as EmailMessage records.

questions.question: What workflow limitation is noted for EmailMessage?
options: Can only update fields on Case
questions.explanation: The noted legacy workflow constraint is update usage tied to Case records.

questions.question: What happens with custom currency fields on EmailMessage?
questions.explanation: That field type is not supported for EmailMessage in this context.

questions.question: When using Gmail/O365 to send, where is email delivery info checked?
questions.explanation: Delivery telemetry is managed by the external sender service, not Salesforce logs.

questions.question: If Bounce Management is not working, what common cause applies?
questions.explanation: Bounce handling has limitations when outbound mail is routed through external accounts.

questions.question: How are workflow/trigger emails sent even if users use external Gmail sending?
questions.explanation: System automation emails continue to be sent via Salesforce.

questions.question: What is the max signature length in My Email Settings?
questions.explanation: The documented signature cap is 1333 characters.

questions.question: Where do you create shared resources like demo rooms or vehicles?
questions.explanation: Calendar resources are managed under Public Calendars and Resources.

questions.question: Which checkbox must be selected to make a newly created resource usable?
questions.explanation: Without Active enabled, the resource remains unavailable for team scheduling.

questions.question: Which view compares multiple users' schedules in side-by-side columns?
questions.explanation: Availability view shows parallel calendars, helping teams find overlapping free slots.
